basic_info.description: Introducing 80 Sycamore Street, a truly exceptional opportunity showcasing the highest level of contemporary refinement and bold architectural design. Featuring a striking modern aesthetic, it seamlessly blends steel, glass, wood, and natural light to create a harmonious collection of materials. This spectacular penthouse spanning the top 3 floors with 3 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, soaring ceilings, dramatic architectural skylights, an incredible family room with marble accents, impressive panoramic roof deck with spa and built-in BBQ, and elevator access to all interior levels. Nestled in the prime Valencia Corridor of the Mission District, it's just steps away from Valencia Street, renowned for its gourmet restaurants, cafes, boutiques, and picturesque parks.
